items.statement: The submitted investigation establishes a converged stationary point and validates it as a minimum for the public neutral singlet molecule.
items.expected: Identity, charge and multiplicity are checked; convergence is documented; no imaginary frequencies are reported for the accepted state.

items.statement: The agent records enough method and analysis provenance to reproduce the reported observables and defines descriptor formulas/sign conventions.
items.expected: Software, method, basis, geometry strategy, provenance and formulas are explicit.

items.statement: The final report contains the requested frontier-orbital energies, gap and global conceptual-DFT descriptors with units.
items.expected: All ten requested observables are present, numerically typed and unit-labelled, with internally coherent derivation.
